title: Biblically Inaccurate
body:
# _**Datapack is WIP,features subject to change.**_

![Biblically Inaccurate,New World to explore.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b26f9246f94bbc400561b5c6a56c5332588f079.png)
> _"A datapack changing minecraft progression,combat and boss fights."_
> 
Biblically Inaccurate is a datapack developed with 3 key ideas in mind:

- Difficulty
- Combat
- Gameplay






## Difficulty

Biblically Inaccurate (B.I. for short) changes the difficulty of the game in 4 ways:

### Progression
-Slower Early Game
-Harder lategame

### Harsher Enviroment

-Some Wild plants are poisonous to walk through

-Soul Sand withers mobs without proper *enchanted* protection

-Fires are more dangerous

-Wolfs are Naturally Hostile unless you have bones

and more..



### Mob Abilities

-A Select few mobs can use special (weak) abilities (randomly) to kill/ambush the player.

-Some just get a Temporary buff

-Skeletons get Totem of undying

### More Hostiles

-Wolfs & Bears are hostile towards players

## Combat

### Enchantments

-**40~ Enchantments** that Include Armor,Weapons & (Near Heavily WIP) Magic.
Some introducing new mechanics like:

-Parrying

  **Crouch before an attack to parry it**,ensures 0 damage dealt to user + heal them a bit, also damages nearby enemies
  
-Guarding

 **Crouch at least half a sec (0.5s) before an attack** to block it,damage is reduced based on enchantment level,with max level **reducing 100% damage**.

 ### Bosses

 B.I.'s Main goal & Inspiration has been Souls franchise with the idea of bringing new bosses with their own weaknesses and abilities into Minecraft.Currently,B.I. Offers **12** Completely new bosses
 and 3 modified current boss mobs,resulting in a number of **15** bosses,all with their own loots and caviats,mostly inspired by other games & franchises,Good Luck.

 Noteable Bosses:

- The Ender Dragon
  
- Artoath the Mimicer

- Archangel Michael

- <details><summary>???</summary>God..That's why it's Biblically Inaccurate</details>

and many more to come..

### Combos

B.I. has brought forth 15+ Weapon-based enchants and with that much variety,there has been introduced a variety of enchantment combos & tecniques which have enhanced PVP battles and made them slightly more fun.
  

## Gameplay

B.I.'s secondary objective other than torturing you with it's difficulty,has been **enhancing** already existing **gameplay features** and making things a bit less annoying..

-Quality of Life Features

- Melting Enchant,smelts ores
- Craftable Saddles,Flint from gravel etc etc.
- Obtainable Spawners with Silk Touch (+Craftable Spawn eggs so they're usable)
- Campfires can be used to create torches,smelt some ores & more..
- Self-Repair enchant,although slow,gradual repairment of gear when equipped.
- More to come
- Defeating Bosses Grants passive effects like Regen & Strength

### Pillager Rearmament

Pillagers have been SEVERELY buffed in this datapack,equipped with Shotgun,Sniper & RPG Crossbows,Pillagers are now ready to raid villages with their new enhanced Ravagers and Artillery.Have fun fighting a quadrupled pillager millitary budget!

### Wither Skeleton Corruption

Nowhere is safe,not even in the very safe dimension called 'Nether'.Due to the introduction of infectious soul sand,mobs can be 'infected' into wither skeletons

# Planned Features

- Magic System (Implemented,not complete)
- Teleport-Based Bow & Trident Enchants (Implemented,experimental)
- Boss Music System
- Extensive Config Menu/Commands
- Mob-Support for enchants like Parry,Guard etc..
